name: Journey TD
summary:
Journey TD is a single-player tower defense game with roguelite progression and pixel art graphics. In each run, players draft towers from six elements – Fire, Ice, Storm, Darkness, Poison and the unlockable Astral element – and place them on procedurally generated maps, where the towers form the maze the enemies have to walk through. A builder character walks across the map and constructs every tower. Three identical towers can be merged into a higher rank, and power-up cards drafted during the run strengthen towers and elements. At fixed waves, a DPS arena tests the damage output of the current build.

The game offers three modes (150 waves, 300 waves and endless) and six difficulty levels. Between runs, progress carries over through builder equipment, skill trees, power runes, unlockable skins, achievements and a collection album of tower cards. Runs are ranked on Steam leaderboards. The game is available in English and German at the moment.
